transcription: My boyfriend broke up with me because of the pancakes I made. I 28 female dated a guy who I'll call nose for Aatu. He was 38. At first, he was charming. I even liked him. Until he became controlling. And violent. He'd get physical with me. But what pushed me over the edge was getting rejected by a literary agent. I've always dreamt of getting published. My parents fought a lot. So, I grew up mostly in my room, writing. I escaped through literature and art. I was passionate. I even corresponded with the surrealist painter Leonora Carrington when I was 11. My grandfather knew her. Nose for Aatu asked to read what I submitted. A prose poem written as a screenplay for a movie impossible to film, but can only exist in words. I even made a two-hour long soundtrack to a company reading it. I spent seven years working on this. No constructive criticism. He just said you're terrible. Give up. He read some of what I wrote out loud. Mocking me. I went home and cried. I couldn't take it anymore. I asked myself what would Leonora Carrington do if she were in my position? Luis Bounuel once invited her to his love nest to sleep with her. She found the place poorly decorated. So, she painted the walls with her menstrual blood while he was in the bathroom. He never spoke to her again. I wanted to end things with nose for Aatu like a proper surrealist. I texted him I made pancakes. He arrived. It smells like fish in here. He noted, it's the pancakes, I said, laughing. He thought I was joking. Until he sat down. Started eating. Immediately, he stopped. His face was filled with disgust. I was nervous. I explained, pretending to be attractive, what I sweeten those pancakes with. Lady syrup. Girl goo. Mermaid marinade. Law crembed to meow meow. I was slowly unbuttoning my shirt while giving this explanation. When I was done, my breasts were fully exposed. But the thought of having eaten foul feminine secretions, combined with the pungent fishy taste, sent nose for Aatu sprinting to the bathroom to vomit. He came back out. He exploded. Called me disgusting. He said I must have an infection.
